title: India Update — May 09, 2026
summary: Historic state elections reshaped India's political landscape: BJP won West Bengal for the first time in the party's 46-year history (206/294 seats), ending 15 years of TMC rule. Kerala's left-wing government fell after five decades, while film star Vijay's TVK party broke 59 years of Dravidian dominance in Tamil Nadu, with Vijay set to be sworn in as Chief Minister. India also marked the one-year anniversary of Operation Sindoor, reaffirming its counter-terror doctrine. The Union Cabinet approved two new semiconductor manufacturing projects worth ₹3,936 crore under the India Semiconductor Mission. India-US tech cooperation deepened with $1.1B in Indian investments at the SelectUSA summit.
